description: This file defines the ISensorCentral interface, which provides method signatures for initializing sensor management, getting and setting sensor values, managing listeners, and accessing sensor value sources within the project.

classes.name: ISensorCentral
classes.description: An interface that abstracts sensor management functionalities such as initialization, value retrieval and setting, listener management, and obtaining sensor value sources.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the sensor central with the given engine state.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Retrieves the current value of the specified sensor.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets the value for the specified sensor.

methods.name: setAnySensorListener
methods.description: Assigns a listener that responds to any sensor updates.

methods.name: addListener
methods.description: Adds a listener for updates from a specific sensor.

methods.name: removeListener
methods.description: Removes a listener from a specific sensor.

methods.name: getValueSource
methods.description: Retrieves the source of a sensor's value.
